messages:
ania: heads-up — I started a dry-run for the recompute/replay flow (recompute-stitcher v2) targeting last week's EU aggregates. found a couple of routing/quota edgecases we should call out.

mike: nice. what's the highest-risk thing?

ania: two things: 1) the /reprocess API currently charges tokens against the tenant quota at job creation, not actual processed rows. that makes backfills look expensive and blocks tenants with thin quotas. 2) routing: we fallback to general pool if priority lanes are full, which doubles work if the original lane later finishes and writes duplicates.

zach: oof, duplicates are the worst. are you seeing idempotency keys on the backfill tasks?

ania: not reliably. the stitcher emits a recompute_id but it's not enforced on ingest path for partial-hour aggregates. so if a fallback write and a primary write both apply, counts can be double-counted.

priya: product question — how visible is this to users right now? are they seeing spikes on the console?

ania: console shows the aggregate increment but no provenance. we have a 'recompute' label in logs but no dashboard metric for replay-health or dedupe-failures. tenants just see higher numbers and sometimes cost surprises.

sam: quick thought: change billing to meter "processed rows" and only bill when a write is committed (post-dedupe). that buys time to implement idempotency.

mike: can we change the API shape without breaking existing clients? we have external usage of /v1/recompute that expects immediate acceptance + quota charge.

ania: proposal: keep immediate acceptance but move quota debit to "commit" stage. add a lightweight lease token returned at acceptance that must be presented for any commit attempts. keeps clients compatible and avoids overcharging.

zach: for routing, I'd rather prefer "soft-reserve" of priority lanes: on acceptance, allocate a slot token with TTL. if the request gets routed out, the token prevents duplicate downstream writes for that recompute_id. if TTL expires, the token can be reclaimed.

priya: timeline/UX ask: can we add a progress estimator in console that shows cost estimate + potential duplicate risk? customers asked for cost transparency.

mike: ok, prioritization: infra changes (lease token + billing move) are medium effort. routing soft-reserve is small-ish. console estimator is product work. we should triage into a 2-week spike followed by a rollout.

ania: spike tasks I propose: 1) add lease token to /v1/recompute accept response and propagate to stitcher. 2) instrument ingest path to check recompute_id+lease and reject duplicate writes. 3) add metric "replay.dedupe.rejected" and surface in console. 4) change billing pipeline to record billed_rows post-commit.

sam: also add a canary toggle in config so Dedicated customers can keep old behavior for a release window.

zach: +1 for canary. also suggest a short TTL (10m) for the lease token to avoid long pinning, with ability to renew from the stitcher.

priya: I'll scope the console changes: - estimator card that uses queued_rows * avg_row_cost - a "risk" badge if dedupe metrics are non-zero - an ops export for customers to see which replays touched which partitions.

mike: blockers? dependencies?

ania: infra: small schema change to replay job table to store lease_token and status transitions. billing: need to delay the charge hook. ingest: fast path dedupe check. console: new metrics from telemetry pipeline.

zach: I'll open a SRE ticket for the dedupe check on ingest; we should load-test the check under high qps.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: recompute-stitcher v2-dryrun -> staging at 2026-03-12T09:14:00Z :rocket:

mike: next steps: 1) spike PRs for lease token + ingest check this week (owners: ania, zach) 2) billing change design doc from sam 3) console mockups from priya by EOD Fri. any objections?

priya: no objections. I'll sync with customer success for messaging templates in case we change billing semantics.

ania: thanks — will post PR links here when ready.

mike: great thread. small ask: add a short blurb to eng-oncall about the new replay.dedupe.rejected alert so they know to not pager for expected replays.

zach: will do.

ania: PRs: https://git.internal/redwood/recompute/pulls/482 (lease token), https://git.internal/redwood/stitcher/pulls/211 (ingest dedupe check) — both in draft.

mike: perfect — moving to implementation lane. :thumbsup:
